name: plan-manager.investigate
purpose: Compose one plan-owned trigger observation and domain brief into a bounded Agent Manager investigation.

phase_generation.description: Phase generation used for trigger correlation.

question.description: Versioned domain question; it cannot authorize mutation.

run_ids.description: Explicit evidence run IDs, at most eight.

wait_seconds.description: One bounded collection wait, capped at 300 seconds.

assumptions: Plan Manager owns trigger eligibility and supplies the current execution, phase generation, and brief reference.
agent-manager.investigate is the registered reusable library entry and owns finite diagnosis, evidence, and result identity.
A pending nested result remains pending; this wrapper does not poll, retry, or apply recommendations.
invariants: Exactly one library investigation call is made after validation.
The caller key, plan execution identity, phase generation, brief reference, question, explicit run IDs, and optional typed brief evidence are passed as bounded context.
No plan state mutation or subject intervention is performed by this program.
The envelope is printed exactly once on every path.

signals.summary: Nested investigation identity, standing, and diagnostic-only disposition.

outputs.evidence: Trigger, execution, phase, brief, and nested investigation identities.

budget.async_reason: nested diagnosis may exceed the synchronous submission bound
